scope: Incremental backend supporting-volume comparison; full S11-T02 acceptance remains open.

baseline.limitations: Backend supporting-volume checkpoint, not full T02 acceptance. Fresh application per invocation; PostgreSQL/OS caches are not flushed and fixture insertion warms them. Cold denotes each actor's first projection after fixture setup. Memory is observed caller-process heap at query boundaries, excluding pool processes/off-heap allocations. Fetched term bytes use Erlang external_size of returned row terms, not wire bytes. SQL bytes include the whole parameterized statement. Browser, complete policy-compilation time, full BEAM peak and actual wire bytes remain unmeasured. No serving database writes. Synthetic bulk fixture setup; reads use the actual runtime login and tenant authorization gates.
